pairs.why: A's stone keeps the real card's lavender-purple tint while B's is grayer; grass and tile palette are otherwise nearly the same.
B's darker, calmer green and quieter orange background match the real card's rich shadowed green and muted red-orange, while A pushes a hot yellow glow and neon lime.
Both use a yellow-green striped background instead of the real card's cooler teal-green, and both rings are a lighter orange than the real red-orange.
A's brown-gray rock is a believable local color against saturated flame and blue, while B's mauve rock is pushed to an off-palette hue.
Both have near-identical vivid yellow-green grass, lavender-gray stone and navy and cream tiles.
A's sky is lighter and more muted with a softer lavender-to-peach fade, like the real card, while B's purple is deeper and louder.
A's hat is a chromatic dark purple, like the real navy cap and its saturated darks, while B's is near-neutral black.
B's blue-navy body gives a cool hue family and a related shadow color like the real cards' blues, while A's black body with yellow stripes and brown ties is warmer.
